title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
description_html:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role

Crusoe's Platform Engineering team builds the services that automate how we manage our cloud fleet. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll design and ship modular microservices on top of our underlying infrastructure, turning stakeholder requirements into platform capabilities that directly drive feature delivery and revenue.



What You'll Be Working On

 - Design, build, and operate microservices that automate fleet provisioning, lifecycle, and capacity management

 - Extend existing platform services with new features that directly drive customer-facing delivery

 - Turn ambiguous stakeholder requirements into clear, modular designs and drive them to production

 - Build on GCP and managed Kubernetes, working closely with infrastructure and cross-functional teams

 - Own the reliability and observability of the services you ship



What You'll Bring to the Team

 - 5+ years building and operating production backend or platform services

 - Strong proficiency in at least one backend language such as Go, Python, Java, or C#

 - Experience designing microservices and APIs (gRPC/REST) in distributed systems

 - Hands-on experience with Postgres and event-driven systems such as Kafka

 - A track record of leading projects end-to-end and raising the bar for engineers around you



Bonus Points

 - Experience building on GCP, AWS, or managed Kubernetes

 - Capacity management or fleet/hardware lifecycle experience

 - Neocloud or GPU cloud infrastructure experience

 - Experience with Go

 - Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana)



Benefits

 - Industry competitive pay

 - Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well-funded technology company

 - Health insurance package options that include HDHP and PPO, vision, and dental for you and your dependents

 - Employer contributions to HSA accounts

 - Paid Parental Leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Teladoc

 - 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of salary

 - Generous paid time off and holiday schedule

 - Cell phone reimbursement

 - Tuition reimbursement

 - Subscription to the Calm app

 - MetLife Legal

 - Company paid commuter benefit; $300 per month
   
   

Compensation

Compensation will be paid in the range of $170,000 - $205,000. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

title: AI Security Engineer
Software Engineer, Infrastructure Engineering
Senior Test Infrastructure Engineer
description_html: NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of PC gaming, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI—the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a learning machine that constantly evolves by pursuing hard problems that matter to the world. Join our growing team and help create the reliable test infrastructure that enables the next generation of Data Center products. We are looking to hire a Test Infrastructure Engineer to join NVIDIA’s Test Solutions Group and build the infrastructure foundation for manufacturing system of board and system products at Contract Manufacturer sites. In this role, you will apply systems, hardware, software, and automation expertise to ensure test environments are reliable, scalable, secure, and ready to support high-volume manufacturing. You will own the engineering of test-dedicated infrastructure—including tester provisioning and configuration, test compute and storage, automation, logging, monitoring, DHCP requirements, and incident recovery—while partnering with CM site operations and IT teams on shared dependencies.    What You'll Be Doing:    Build and operate the initial CM test infrastructure service stack: test compute, storage, tester provisioning, configuration, automation scripts, DHCP, log collection, diagnostic logs, and test-related file transfer.  Establish standards for tester images, configuration baselines, inventory, naming, access, patching, and lifecycle management.  Automate tester provisioning, configuration, recovery, health checks, and log collection using infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management tools.  Develop service runbooks, monitoring dashboards, alerts, incident procedures, and paths for handling blocking issues for each supported service.  Partner with CM site operations on physical deployment, break/fix, remote access, rack-and-stack, power, and equipment replacement.  Work with IT teams to ensure test infrastructure follows enterprise identity/access, network, security, DNS, patching, backup, and hardware standards.  Identify capacity, reliability, security, and operational risks; drive corrective actions before they affect test throughput.     What We Need To See:     8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, test engineering, lab operations, or technical operations.  Bachelors degree or equivalent experience.  Strong hands-on Linux administration and ability to solve issues.  Experience with servers, storage, networking fundamentals, remote-management controllers, and hardware/lab environments.  Experience with automation and configuration management, such as Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform, CI/CD, or equivalent.  Experience with logging, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis.  Ability to work independently across distributed teams, CM partners, and IT organizations.  Clear written communication and strong operational rigor.     Ways to Stand Out From Crowd:     Experience supporting hardware validation, factory/CM operations, data centers, or large-scale test labs.  Experience with GPU/server platforms, DHCP/DNS, PXE boot, golden images, KVM/console systems, and asset management.  Familiarity with storage systems, high-speed networking, observability platforms, and security tooling.  Experience building a new operational capability or taking ambiguous infrastructure ownership from multiple teams    With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you. Come build the future with us!     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 152,000 USD – 253,000 USD for Level 4; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 5.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 6, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         The Experience      Join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, where you work alongside Infrastructure and Research and Development partners to keep Salesforce cloud services available for customers around the clock.    With Agentforce woven into every layer of our platform, you help build resilient systems that millions of customers depend on every day.    This role is based in Herndon, VA and is eligible for an onsite work arrangement.    Candidates must have an active TS/SCI with Polygraph clearance.        What You'll Actually Be Doing      Monitor customer-facing services and respond to Severity 0 and Severity 1 incidents, leading technical reviews and contributing to root cause analyses.    Automate the detection and resolution of recurring production issues to reduce repetitive manual work.    Contribute to compliance, resiliency, and self-healing initiatives, including destructive testing and resiliency drills.    Partner with and mentor teammates to stay current on industry technology and drive team development.       You're Our Person If...      You have experience in enterprise-scale internet service engineering or support, with hands-on experience using the command line on Unix variants, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux.    You have experience with Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) networking technologies and protocols.    You have experience with incident management in a 24/7 environment.    You write scripts in Python, Go, or similar languages and have experience provisioning and operating Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure.       Even Better If...      You have a solid understanding of IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) service operations.    You have experience with configuration management tools such as Chef or Puppet, and pipeline tools such as Jenkins, Bamboo, or Spinnaker.    You have hands-on experience supporting and managing Kubernetes-based applications and services.    You hold certifications in Linux+, Red Hat, or AWS.    You are familiar with Agile processes and DevOps practices.       Changes to know about:     I moved ITIL to "Even Better If" because the guide says required qualifications should be findable on a resume.    "You're Our Person If..." still has four bullets, per the guide's limit.    "Even Better If..." now has five bullets, because I added ITIL. The guide's four-bullet limit covers responsibilities and required qualifications, so this is fine, but you can trim one if you want.    I wrote out "Severity 0 and Severity 1" and removed the "(Sev0)/(Sev1)" acronyms, since they weren't used again.       This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.This position requires a USA TS/SCI with Polygraph security access level.      Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Vulnerability Security Engineer
location: All, Michigan, United States of America
description_html: Vulnerability Security Engineer          This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.                    Who We Are:                               Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.                     Job Description:        About Our Cybersecurity Team  Are you ready to make an impact at one of the world’s leading technology companies? HPE’s Cybersecurity team is where you can do just that. We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced vulnerability management expert to join our team. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of cybersecurity and ready for your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you.   About the Role  As a Vulnerability Security Engineer   at HPE, you will be responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and driving remediation of security vulnerabilities while leveraging automation and AI-driven solutions to reduce cyber risk and improve operational efficiency. Your role will focus on the continuous improvement of the organization's vulnerability management program by identifying, prioritizing, and partnering with technology teams to remediate security vulnerabilities at scale. You will apply your knowledge of vulnerability management   to protect HPE’s applications and infrastructure.   About You  You will bring expertise in vulnerability management tools and platforms to reduce organizational cyber risk by ensuring vulnerabilities are identified, prioritized, and remediated efficiently across enterprise systems, applications, and cloud platforms. You will work independently and contribute to high-impact projects in fast-paced environments, applying advanced expertise across cybersecurity and IT security.  Your experience with vulnerability management, technical security engineering, and stakeholder collaboration/ influence   will be critical. Strong communication skills are essential, enabling you to explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical audiences.   You Will Be Responsible For   Manage the enterprise vulnerability management program, including vulnerability identification, assessment, prioritization, and remediation tracking.    Perform and maintain vulnerability scanning across servers, endpoints, cloud environments, network devices, containers, and applications.    Analyze vulnerability scan results and validate findings to reduce false positives and improve remediation effectiveness.    Partner with infrastructure, cloud, application, and engineering teams to drive timely remediation of security vulnerabilities.    Assess vulnerabilities using CVSS scores, threat intelligence, exploitability, and business risk to prioritize remediation activities.    Monitor emerging threats, zero-day vulnerabilities, and security advisories, providing guidance on organizational impact and required actions.    Develop metrics, dashboards, and reporting to communicate vulnerability trends, remediation performance, and risk reduction to leadership.    Conduct vulnerability assessments and security reviews for new technologies, infrastructure deployments, and cloud services.    Maintain and administer vulnerability management tools such as Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys, CrowdStrike Exposure Management, or similar platforms.    Collaborate with application security teams to integrate vulnerability management into the software development lifecycle.    Assist with audit, regulatory, and compliance activities by providing evidence and reporting related to vulnerability management controls.    Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions that streamline vulnerability management processes, improve operational efficiency, and reduce manual effort across security and technology teams.    Evaluate, implement, and optimize AI-driven security capabilities to enhance vulnerability analysis, risk prioritization, remediation workflows, and data-driven cybersecurity decision-making.    Education & Experience Requirements   Required    6+ years of experience in vulnerability management, security engineering, cybersecurity operations, or a related security discipline.    Experience conducting vulnerability assessments and coordinating remediation activities across infrastructure, cloud, and application environments.    Hands-on experience with vulnerability management platforms such as Rapid7 InsightVM, Qualys, Tenable Nessus, CrowdStrike Exposure Management, or equivalent tools.    Knowledge of vulnerability scoring methodologies, including CVSS, EPSS, and risk-based prioritization approaches.    Experience supporting Windows, Linux, cloud, and network technologies.    Understanding of common security vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and attack techniques.    Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.    Familiarity with security frameworks and standards including NIST, CIS Controls, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.    Experience creating executive-level metrics, dashboards, and risk reporting.    Preferred    Experience with vulnerability management automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar).    Experience integrating vulnerability findings into ticketing and workflow platforms such as ServiceNow or Jira.    Knowledge of application security concepts including SAST, DAST, container security, and software composition analysis.    Professional certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GSEC, GCIH, CISSP, or equivalent.    Experience supporting large enterprise environments and risk-based vulnerability management programs.        Accessibility    HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked  here .    Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. Personal & Professional Development   We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.     Unconditional Inclusion   We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
